goal: Freeze deterministic CPU-synthetic token routing, expert residency and non-adaptive policy replay above the sole Phase 4 scheduler.
scope: byte-authoritative expert and reserved nonexpert capacity
explicit clean eviction, H2D load, route barrier and compute assignment DAG
non_goals: routing weights or weighted expert combination
multi-GPU, NVLink, P2P or coherent UMA
model, benchmark, GPU, profiling or calibration execution

dependencies.phase2_ir: token-level routing identity and provenance semantics

assumptions: Selected expert IDs and top-k have passed the frozen token-level IR boundary.
Expert sizes and nonexpert reservation are frozen byte counts.
Policy actions are fully compiled before the Phase 4 scheduler starts.
unknowns: measured residency and transfer service curves
alternative_designs: Dynamic completion callbacks were deferred because frozen Phase 4 has no dynamic submission API.
Aggregate routing reconstruction was rejected because it cannot conserve token identity.
Terminal-state plus earlier-cursor checkpointing was rejected in favor of a real live prefix.
risks: The serialized token chain is a minimal deterministic implementation rather than a production serving scheduler.
Synthetic service work cannot support latency, speedup or break-even claims.
Prefetch hints are useful only when their earlier arrival and target provenance are available.
validation_method: native Phase 5 and inherited Phase 3/4 ASAN/UBSAN execution
routing, assignment, capacity, causality and ablation tests
live object and wire checkpoint exact-continuation tests
tamper, corruption, invalid enum, invalid routing and capacity negative tests
sealed run and candidate exact-set checksum validation
acceptance_criteria: three roles GO on one candidate ledger with empty blockers
owner_decisions: Phase 4 GO authorizes Phase 5 CPU-synthetic routing, residency and policy implementation.
Push is permitted after each completed phase.
next_legal_action: After same-hash GO, freeze Phase 5 and begin Phase 6 CPU-synthetic multi-GPU NVLink and coherent UMA implementation.
forbidden_actions: modification or reinterpretation of frozen G3 or S4 evidence

stale_run.reason: The run began before the implementation agent completed the final reserved-capacity replay checks.
stale_run.promotion_policy: excluded from the candidate ledger; never promote or reinterpret
